messages:
sara: Quick intake for Peregrine11b — want to run a conservative canary tomorrow AM. summary + checklist below, please react with :thumbsup: if you can own items.

mike: I can take the quantization experiments. planning int8/llm.int8 and a float16 baseline.

jia: I'll own canary rollout config and monitoring dashboards. what are the SLA targets?

sara: Target P95 <= 220ms host, <= 140ms dedicated; latency alert at +30% from baseline. cost target: <1.25x current raven-13b cost for similar quality.

oliver: Any known tokenization differences? will need evals for safety regressions.

natalie: I'll prep eval suites — standard perf + customer prompt set + regen tests. planning a small adversarial prompt split.

mike: Notes from local quant tests: int8 post-training-aware gives ~1.9x throughput, latency +8% per-token. quality delta: rouge/accuracy within 0.6% on our evals.

mike: posting the simple repro command I used:
```bash
python quant_eval.py --model peregrine11b --method lltq --batch 8 --seq 512 --metrics perplexity,acc
```

jia: For canary routing plan: 1% global traffic -> 5% after 30m if no regressions -> 20% after 2h -> scale per policy. fallback stack: peregrine11b-int8 -> peregrine11b-fp16 -> raven-13b.

sara: Good. Also include region fallback: EU region uses dedicated pool A, fallback to hosted region in case of CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED.

oliver: Smoke tests to run on promotion: generate on 50 short prompts, 10 long prompts; check for hallucination spikes and response truncation. Add KV-cache warmup step.

natalie: Eval plan:
- automated regression run (devbench + customer prompts)
- toxicity/safety checks via safety_runner v2
- ngram overlap checks with golden set
- embedding drift check (cos sim threshold 0.82)

mike: Quant flags to try during canary: `--kv-precision fp16`, `--cache-prefix opt`, and disable continuous-batching for first 5m to measure cold-latency.

jia: Canary config snippet for console routes:
```json
{
  "route": "/v1/generate/peregrine",
  "weight": 0.01,
  "fallbacks": ["peregrine-int8","peregrine-fp16","raven-13b"],
  "health_checks": {"latency_p95_ms": 300, "error_rate": 0.01}
}
```

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: canary job peregrine-canary-1918002468 queued by sara. ETA 08:15 UTC.

sara: Warmup tasks: prefill KV cache with top-50 customer prefixes (script in infra/warmup/peregrine_prefill.sh). Run prefill 15m before first traffic.

oliver: Observability: add streaming token-level breakdown, per-route cost estimator, and regression alert that triggers rollback if quality delta > 1.2% on key metrics.

mike: Performance checklist before 5% bump:
- warmup success (prefill log shows 95% hit on sample prefixes)
- 5m latency baseline stable within 15%
- memory usage < 92% on pod

jia: Rollback triggers: any of the following -> automatic rollback to previous route: (1) P95 > configured alert for 5m window, (2) error_rate > 2% sustained 3m, (3) eval quality delta > 1.2% on core_prompt_set.

natalie: Post-canary eval cadence: immediate regression job, then 24h extended QA (sampling 1k recent queries). Document anomalies in the onboarding ticket.

sara: Can we get a quick cost estimate for int8 vs fp16 at 20% traffic? mike?

mike: Rough calc: int8 ~0.62x unit-cost vs fp16; with >20% batching gains overall cost ~0.55x. I'll add numbers in the ticket.

oliver: Security notes: ensure KMS keys are applied for private deployments, and include audit log toggle for Private customers.

jia: Private deployment special steps: run on-prem smoke then replicate canary traffic using `replay-client --source sample-traffic.json --rate 50qps` to dedicated cluster.

sara: Ok owners: mike (quant & perf), jia (canary config + monitoring), natalie (evals), oliver (safety + security). I'll kick the canary job tomorrow 08:15 UTC. please ack.

mike: ack :thumbsup:

jia: ack :thumbsup:

oliver: ack :thumbsup:

natalie: ack :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary started: peregrine-canary-1918002468 at 08:15:23 UTC. route weight 1%.

sara: thanks team. will re-open thread if any red flags.
